detail.longDescription: No volume. No database. Nothing left to lose. ihasmail's new IMMUTABLE=1 mode closes the "stateless" gap for real: read-only root filesystem, no mounted volume, nothing written to disk. The server checks its own claim at boot rather than trusting it — it refuses to start if the filesystem turns out writable after all. One honest trade-off: everyone gets signed out on every deploy. Full writeup: https:// linuxexpert.org/ihasmail-immut able-webmail-docker/ # SelfHosted # Linux # Docker # JMAP # FOSS
